name: io.github.Djangode/sjothr-mcp
title: Sjothr startup raises and credit risk market
description: Sjothr on Base: startup raises, credit risk tranches, resale Market, unsigned transactions.

tools.name: sjothr_campaigns
tools.description: Public fundraising campaigns on Sjothr: company token, state, funding goal and capital raised in USDC, deadline and public record page.

tools.name: sjothr_campaign
tools.description: Public record of one Sjothr campaign by campaign id: token, vault, funding goal, capital raised, deadline, state and dossier reference.

tools.name: sjothr_rules
tools.description: Rules of a Sjothr raise: who pays which fee, how capital is released in stages by token-holder votes, when backers are refunded, and the risks.

tools.name: sjothr_prepare
tools.description: Unsigned transactions to invest an amount of USDC in one Sjothr raise, from the contract's own quote: the USDC allowance, then the purchase. The 10% fee is paid by the backer on top of the amount. To be signed and sent in order by the user's or the agent's own wallet; nothing is signed or sent by this server.

amount.description: USDC that go to the round vault, digits with an optional decimal point, for example 25.5

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send

tools.name: sjothr_risk_portfolios
tools.description: Verified loan-book portfolios on the Sjothr credit risk market: company first loss, tranches (band, size, covered, yearly premium or premium cap, accepted guarantee), offer deadline, protection dates, lending of the guarantees and page.

tools.name: sjothr_risk_portfolio
tools.description: One credit risk portfolio by id: its terms and tranches, the open offers of each tranche (premium and amount covered) and the guarantor positions for sale with their price.

tools.name: sjothr_risk_positions
tools.description: Credit risk positions held by one wallet: portfolio, band, amount covered, guarantee, premium and interest to collect, sale price if listed, released or not.

tools.name: sjothr_risk_prepare
tools.description: Unsigned transactions for one credit risk action, checked against the contract for this wallet. Guarantor: cover (offer on a tranche at a yearly premium), withdraw_offer, collect (premium and interest), sell, unlist, buy, release (after the end), contest (a signed claim, with its bond). Credit company: publish (from its public anonymous loan file), close_offers, cancel, pay_premium, file_claim (loans in default from the loan file, with the public claim dossier), withdraw_claim, file_report (quarterly report), return_recovery, take_back_premium, replace_firm (when its firm was disowned). Verification firm: sign_engagement (with its EAS business attestation), attest, file_claim (signed at once), sign_claim, refuse_claim, sign_report. Juror: vote (hidden: keep your salt), reveal. Anyone: pay_claim, resolve, end. To be signed and sent in order by the user's or the agent's own wallet; nothing is signed or sent by this server.

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send

poolId.description: Portfolio id (every action on a portfolio)

premium.description: Yearly premium asked, in percent, for example 11.5 (cover)

positionId.description: Position id (collect, sell, unlist, buy, release)

loansUri.description: Public HTTPS, IPFS or Arweave address of the anonymous loan file, CSV loan_id,principal_usdc,rate_bps,maturity,status (publish)

defaultDays.description: Days unpaid that make a loan a default (publish)

firm.description: Address of an eligible verification firm (publish, replace_firm), listed as verifiedFirms by sjothr_tribunal

firstLossPercent.description: Share of the loan book the company keeps first, in percent (publish)

lendingPercent.description: Share of USDC guarantees CantorFi may lend, fixed for life (publish)

criteriaUri.description: Public address of the lending criteria, optional (publish)

loans.description: Loans of the claim: number in the loan file, total loss in USDC for this loan, first unpaid day YYYY-MM-DD (file_claim)

uri.description: Public address of the claim dossier, the quarterly report or the engagement (file_claim, file_report, sign_engagement)

hash.description: keccak256 of the same document's bytes, 0x and 64 hex digits (file_claim, file_report, sign_engagement, attest)

attestation.description: Id of the firm's EAS business attestation, issued to this wallet by a recognized verifier (sign_engagement)

licence.description: Regulator and licence number of the credit company (attest)

companyVerified.description: The firm checked the company's identity and registration (attest)

uphold.description: true: the claim is founded (vote, reveal)

salt.description: Secret 0x and 64 hex digits chosen by the juror, the same for vote and reveal (vote, reveal)

tools.name: sjothr_tribunal
tools.description: Claims of the verified portfolios that guarantors can still contest (loss, dossier, deadline, bond), disputes open to independent jurors (dossier, loan file, ticket, hidden-vote and open-vote deadlines, votes so far) and the verification firms a credit company can choose.

tools.name: sjothr_market
tools.description: Resale of startup tokens before their listing, at the price of the startup's current round (not negotiated): tokens offered by holders (offer id, round, amount) and requests of buyers (request id, amount, USDC deposited), for one startup or all of them.

tools.name: sjothr_market_prepare
tools.description: Unsigned transactions for one startup token resale action, checked against the contract for this wallet: sell (deposit tokens of a successful round for sale), buy (allowance, then a request at the current round price), validate (the seller exchanges its offer with a buyer's request), cancel_offer, cancel_request, collect (USDC from completed sales and cancelled requests). Signed and sent by the user's or the agent's own wallet.

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send

round.description: Round the sold tokens come from, 0 for the first round (sell)

tokens.description: Amount of tokens, digits with an optional decimal point (sell, buy)

tools.name: sjothr_backer
tools.description: One raise seen from one wallet: its rounds (price, deadline, outcome, vault), the round proposed by the founder with its vote, and the wallet's tokens kept by Sjothr, redeemed and claimed, and its vote.

tools.name: sjothr_backer_prepare
tools.description: Unsigned transaction for one backer action, checked against the contract for this wallet: vote_round (for or against the round proposed by the founder), vote_release (for or against the capital release requested in a round, with an amount of kept tokens), refund (base contribution of a raise that missed its goal), redeem (remaining capital of a round, against kept tokens). Signed and sent by the user's or the agent's own wallet.

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Sjothr campaigns, credit risk portfolios and guides (tokenize a company, raise money for a startup, tokenized equity, milestone-based funding, credit risk); returns ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full record of one Sjothr campaign or credit risk portfolio, or full text of one guide, by id (from search).
